title: game-wire common definitions
description: Shared shapes for the client wire contract (docs/03_planning/LLM_MMO_RPG/20_client_wire_contract.md). Nothing here is a message; these are the building blocks every message reuses.

Uint64String.description: CWC-A2 — a 64-bit integer ALWAYS crosses the wire as a decimal string. JS `number` silently corrupts past 2^53, and channel_event_id / turn_number / channel_id are all BIGINT server-side. One rule, no exceptions; enforced by scripts/game-wire-lint.py.

Digest.description: RLS-A13 content address (BLAKE3, hex). The client caches by digest — a digest can never be stale, only unused.

HpBand.description: REC-79 — state travels BESIDE identity, never inside the id token. Numeric hp is never sent for a non-party entity.

x.description: cell-local milli-units (MAP §5 — i32, never f32; TDIL-A9)
